title: Agent 2 (Chat WS, Provider, Model, and User Intent) - P0 Recovery Handoff

root_cause_summary.incident: User submitted 'analise e edite esse video em ingles https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FV93IVwJP_4' with Ollama -> Gemma 4 E4B * High, failing with BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED_BACKGROUND_AI (trigger=unknown).
root_cause_summary.mechanism: When KNOWLEDGE_FIRST is active (default True), incoming WebSocket 'chat_message' in backend/api/chat.py routed directly to KnowledgeChatOrchestrator.handle_video_request() and KnowledgeChatOrchestrator.revise_deliverable() without wrapping the call in an active inference_authorization_context. Consequently, _CURRENT_CONTEXT in backend/llm_trace/context.py was None, which backend/llm_trace/guard.py line 215 correctly rejected as an unauthorized background call.
root_cause_summary.resolution: Established server-authored execution provenance at the WebSocket entry boundary via an async adapter seam 'server_inference_authorization_context(user_id=user_id, correlation_id=correlation_id, run_id=run_id)' using TRIGGER_EXPLICIT_CHAT_SUBMIT. Stripped and disallowed client authorization claims (e.g. authorized=True). Added server-side idempotency/debouncing to suppress duplicate submissions, and verified that provider, exact installed model ID (gemma4:e4b), and reasoning level are forwarded intact without fallback substitution.

chat_message.description: Normalized chat submission from composer or multimodal input

fields.content: string (raw user text with exact YouTube URL casing, e.g. FV93IVwJP_4)

chat_message.security_invariant: Client-supplied 'authorized' or 'trigger' fields are ignored and stripped on the server. Server authors the execution provenance.

revision_request.description: Explicit user request to revise an existing video deliverable

fields.state: string (REQUESTED | PLANNING | RETRIEVING_KNOWLEDGE | COMPOSING | VALIDATING | RENDERING | VIDEO_VERIFIED | REVIEW_READY | FAILED_TERMINAL | BLOCKED)

adapter_seam_contract.fallback_behavior: If backend.llm_trace is unavailable during isolated build, yields a safe dictionary without failing import, preserving zero-crash capability.

observed_real: Local Ollama 11434 responsive with installed model gemma4:e4b (ID: bb027d30ecf5, 10 GB).
Under SIXCLIPS_REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_AUTH=1, server_inference_authorization_context successfully authorized Ollama gemma4:e4b outbound generative calls without BLOCKED_UNAUTHORIZED_BACKGROUND_AI.
Exact YouTube URL 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FV93IVwJP_4' preserved verbatim through UI and WebSocket layers.
Rapid duplicate submissions with identical client_message_id suppressed by MessageDeduplicator (call count = 1).
Unselected model and unselected reasoning effort rejected before inference call with explicit user guidance.
Outcomes for stale/inactive sessions are ignored by useWebSocket without polluting active session state.
Vite frontend builds cleanly with zero errors.
not_yet_observed_peer_scope: Real end-to-end video download and ffmpeg slice of FV93IVwJP_4 in combined integrated environment (A3/A5 integration gate).
Motion graphics review stage canvas render of generated MP4 (A4/A5 integration gate).

integration_instructions_for_a5.potential_conflicts: None anticipated. A2 touched only chat WebSocket and chat components. All A1 llm_trace imports are guarded through the adapter seam in backend/api/chat.py.
